name: Incline Treadmill Walk
instructions: Start the belt at a slow walking speed with no incline and step on.
Raise the incline step by step to your target. A common target is 12% at about 5 km/h (3 mph); start lower if you are new to it.
Stand tall, lean only slightly forward from the ankles, and swing your arms naturally.
Do not hold the handrails. If you must hold them to keep up, lower the speed or the incline.
Walk for the set time, then lower the incline and the speed before you step off.
